listings.title: September Antique & Vintage Quilts, Feedsacks, & Textiles Auction
listings.description: Click Here to BID on this Online Auction!! Our last Quilt Auction of the year! Don't Miss a Stitch! We are offering Antique & Vintage Quilts and Textiles from all over the USA including a Feedsack and Feedsack Quilt Collection from Arkansas, Antique Textiles from the Wheeler Brothers General Store, Quilts from a Northern Kentucky Estate, and the Quilt collection of Christina Suzanne Cawley of West Virginia. Suzanne was an accomplished quilter, showcasing her talent and creativity through her membership in two quilting guilds, Creative Needles and Schoolhouse Quilters as well as an historian and quilt collector, sharing her textiles and knowledge to local groups. We also have the honor of offering part of her Quilt History Library, her Quilt Documentation books, with additional books offered in December. We are also offering a quilt ephemera collection. And much more! Click Here to BID on this Online Auction!!

listings.title: September Design II Collection - $5 Start No Reserve
listings.description: Welcome to our September Design II collection! Bidding on this sale will end on Thursday, September 24th at 8pm. Lots close one-at-a-time with time added if you bid in the last 3 minutes. You can place max bids in advance and the system will bid for you automatically up to your set amount. Good luck and have fun! Open pickup will be held Friday, September 25th and Saturday, September 26th from 10-3pm at 103 W. Franklin St. Media, PA. No appointment is needed during the open pickup days. Alternative pickup times can be scheduled via a Calendly link you'll receive in your invoice. Please bring your own help for large items. Delivery and shipping are available. See the "Auction Info" tab below for details.

listings.title: Doylestown Decorators Dream! Art, RH, Serena & Lily, Herman Miller, C& B, Pottery Barn + More
listings.description: **This private estate auction is PICK UP or THIRD PARTY SHIPPING only from an estate in Doylestown, PA*** SCROLL TO THE BOTTOM OF THIS PAGE FOR MORE DETAILS. Step inside an exceptional private estate filled with beautifully curated furnishings, original artwork, hand-knotted rugs, designer décor, outdoor pieces, collectibles, and more. This home was thoughtfully furnished with a mix of elevated contemporary design, timeless traditional pieces, original art, and distinctive vintage finds. Throughout the collection you’ll find sought-after names including **Pottery Barn, West Elm, Restoration Hardware, Serena & Lily, Crate & Barrel, Jill Rosenwald, Eddie Bauer, Longaberger, Frontgate, Ballard Designs, Arhaus**, and more. The art collection is a standout of this sale, featuring original and collectible works by artists including **Christopher Stott, Gray Malin, Christy Kinard, Jody Paul, Staci Swider, and Miles Talbott**, alongside vintage artwork and other unique pieces collected over time. Also included is an impressive selection of antique and modern hand-knotted rugs, many of which appear to have seen little or no use, as well as designer furniture, decorative accessories, faux botanicals and planters, outdoor furnishings, seasonal and Christmas décor, vintage collectibles, and distinctive pieces for nearly every room of the home. This is the kind of estate where every room offers something worth discovering—from recognizable designer staples to unexpected one-of-a-kind finds.
